Source from LSIFPF12 (lines 50-99 of 1636, 50 lines retrieved):

```abap
  LOCAL: P_FIELD_LIST_INT.

  DATA: CONT   type RPY_DYCATT,
        CONT_A type RPY_DYCATT,
        CONT_S type RPY_DYCATT,
        RADIO_INDEX TYPE I,
        AUTH_COUNT TYPE I,
        L_A_NAME LIKE D021S-FNAM,
        L_CONT_FOUND.


* Typ des direkt übergeordneten Containers des Einzelfeldes bestimmen
  CLEAR CONT.
  CONT-ELEMENT_OF = CONT_SCREEN_NAME.
  L_CONT_FOUND = ' '.
* Subscreen: entweder eigener Container
*            oder Element im TabStrip Control
  IF P_FIELD_INT-FILL = 'B'.
    CONT-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_CTYPE-SUBSCREEN.
    IF P_FIELD_INT-LTYP <> 'I'.
*     eigener Container
      CONT-NAME = P_FIELD_INT-FNAM.
      L_CONT_FOUND = 'X'.
    ELSE.
      CONT-NAME = P_FIELD_INT-FNAM.
*     TabStrip Container suchen
      LOOP AT P_FIELD_LIST_INT
               WHERE FILL = 'I'
               AND   LANF = P_FIELD_INT-LANF.
        IF P_FIELD_LIST_INT-FNAM NE SPACE.
          CONT-ELEMENT_OF = P_FIELD_LIST_INT-FNAM.
        ELSE.
          PERFORM R_CONCAT_CONT_NAME USING P_FIELD_LIST_INT-LANF
                                     CHANGING CONT-ELEMENT_OF.
        ENDIF.
        L_CONT_FOUND = 'X'.
        EXIT.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
* Table Control: eigener Container
  ELSEIF P_FIELD_INT-FILL = 'T'.
    CONT-TYPE = RPYTY_DYNP_CTYPE-TABLE_CONTROL.
    IF P_FIELD_INT-FNAM NE SPACE.
      CONT-NAME = P_FIELD_INT-FNAM.
      L_CONT_FOUND = 'X'.
    ELSE.
      PERFORM R_CONCAT_CONT_NAME USING P_FIELD_INT-LANF
                                 CHANGING CONT-NAME.
      L_CONT_FOUND = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
```
